notes: While 'चीनी' most commonly refers to sugar, it is also the word for 'Chinese' (referring to a person, language, or object). Context is essential to tell them apart.
When referring to a person from China, it can sometimes be perceived as less formal or slightly reductive compared to 'चीनी व्यक्ति' (Chinese person).
In the context of food, it is strictly the uncountable noun for sugar granules.
